map.name: Tideglass Muster
map.description: Recruit a specialist, then hold the breach against three alien waves.

text.objectives: Recruit one specialist before the muster ends; the squad wins by clearing all three waves.
briefing: Move the civilian to one of the marked vendors and spend ore to recruit its displayed unit.
Siege Platform recruits a Dragoon for 90 ore; Field Clinic recruits a Medic for 65 ore; Spine Nest recruits a Hydralisk for 75 ore.
Each player may recruit once. Anyone who has not chosen when the draft timer expires receives the profile fallback unit.
The breach opens after every player has chosen. Defend the north edge and clear each wave before the battle timer expires.

messages.fallback: Muster closed. Your reserve specialist joins the squad.
messages.battle_start: The breach is open. Hold the upper edge and clear each wave.
messages.victory: The final wave is broken. The squad holds the breach.
messages.timeout: The defense timer expired before the breach was secured.

offers.label: Siege Platform
offers.receipt: Dragoon recruited. Long range covers the breach approach.

offers.label: Field Clinic
offers.receipt: Medic recruited. Keep the specialist behind the front line.

offers.label: Spine Nest
offers.receipt: Hydralisk recruited. Its ranged fire supports the center.

waves.clear_message: The first rush is broken. Heavier attackers are approaching.
The ranged wave is clear. A final armored group is inbound.
